title: Q-IMPROVE-fe-font-display: Load web fonts with font-display swap so text shows at once on slow phones
body:
**Owner:** uiux-manager
**Trigger:** improve --run
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::font-display
**Prediction:** uiux:findings_total < 0 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Kind: frontend. Baseline uiux:findings_total = 0. Settled 7 days after it closes: kept if uiux:findings_total moved the right way, else replaced.

Before closing: run the UI/UX audit on the changed pages (`python3 -m foundation uiux --tick` on the platform, the seed's uiux audit in a tenant), keep Core Web Vitals inside budget (LCP <= 2.5 s, CLS <= 0.1, INP <= 200 ms), and pass the human-voice check on every changed line of copy. A change that adds a blocking finding is reverted, not waived.

**Closing probe:** grep:site/worker.js::font-display

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T23:52:10Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
